sessions.title: Learn functions and their properties
sessions.objective: Identify domain, range, monotonicity, and even or odd symmetry of a function.

sessions.title: Learn linear and quadratic functions
sessions.objective: Find the slope of a linear function and the vertex of a quadratic at x = -b/(2a).

sessions.title: Learn limits and one-sided limits
sessions.objective: Evaluate limits from the left and right and recognise infinite limits and asymptotes.

sessions.title: Practice limits and one-sided limits
sessions.objective: Compute one-sided and infinite limits from graphs and formulas.

sessions.title: Learn continuity
sessions.objective: Check the three continuity conditions and classify discontinuities by type.

sessions.title: Learn limit laws and indeterminate forms
sessions.objective: Apply limit laws and resolve 0/0 by factoring, rationalising, or combining fractions.

sessions.title: Practice indeterminate forms
sessions.objective: Evaluate limits of rational and radical expressions that give 0/0 or infinity/infinity.

sessions.title: Learn trigonometric limits and the squeeze theorem
sessions.objective: Use lim sin(x)/x = 1 to evaluate trigonometric limits.

sessions.title: Learn the derivative at a point
sessions.objective: Write the difference quotient and interpret it as slope and instantaneous rate of change.

sessions.title: Practice derivative from the limit definition
sessions.objective: Compute f'(a) from the limit definition and find tangent line equations.

sessions.title: Learn differentiability and higher-order derivatives
sessions.objective: Explain why differentiability implies continuity but not conversely, and compute second derivatives.

sessions.title: Practice higher-order derivatives
sessions.objective: Find second and third derivatives and interpret acceleration.

sessions.title: Learn basic differentiation rules
sessions.objective: Apply the constant, power, sine, cosine, and linearity rules.

sessions.title: Practice basic differentiation rules
sessions.objective: Differentiate sums and constant multiples of basic functions without error.

sessions.title: Learn product and quotient rules
sessions.objective: State and apply the product and quotient rules with nonzero denominators.

sessions.title: Practice product and quotient rules
sessions.objective: Differentiate products and ratios of functions, simplifying the result.

sessions.title: Learn the chain rule
sessions.objective: Differentiate composite functions by multiplying outer and inner derivatives.

sessions.title: Practice chain rule
sessions.objective: Differentiate nested compositions and combine with product and quotient rules.

sessions.title: Practice chain rule with mixed rules
sessions.objective: Solve mixed differentiation problems under timed conditions.

sessions.title: Review chain rule and differentiation
sessions.objective: Revisit the most error-prone differentiation patterns from the course.
